title: Final 08B 2 — pocisk i trafienie środkowy cel
description:
Druga kinetyczna odpowiedź Belicosy ma odmienną, boczną gramatykę. Kamera obserwuje działo i niebo z profilu, a następnie prowadzi wzrok równolegle do pojedynczego pocisku z niebieskim rdzeniem biegnącego do środkowego małego biookrętu. W jednym szerokim układzie czytelne są jednocześnie sylwetka lufy, boczny tor pocisku i niebieski organ celu; pozostałe dwie małe jednostki oraz statek-matka pozostają nietknięte.

Odrzut jest cięższy niż za pierwszym razem: mokra papa faluje przy podstawie, podpory przesuwają drobny gruz, z chłodzenia wydostaje się krótka para, a na powierzchni dachu pojawiają się pierwsze włoskowate pęknięcia. Jeden wystrzał prowadzi do jednego trafienia zgodnego z niebieskim kodem amunicji; nie ma dodatkowych wiązek, celów ani efektów gry.

prompts.image: Photorealistic cinematic 16:9 second-volley Start Frame. A 24 mm combat camera lies at wet roof level extremely close and parallel to the canonical Belicosa barrel, canted about eight degrees. The massive single continuous barrel tears diagonally from the lower-left foreground toward the upper-right sky. Exactly one compact white-hot projectile with a saturated BLUE core has just cleared the far rectangular muzzle and races toward only the central small bio-ship's intact blue organ; it is discrete ammunition, never a continuous laser. One support and the circular base slam into the wet roof at the lower edge, roofing water and black grit burst toward the lens, cables snap taut and a short pressure cloud vents. Selective motion blur affects spray and debris while cannon and target remain readable. Exactly four ships remain: one colossal brood ship and three small yellow-, blue- and pink-red-organ attackers. War-correspondent immediacy, hard blue light grazing rain-black steel. No Czeslaw, impact, second projectile, extra ship, extra barrel, UI, text, logos or watermark.
prompts.animation:
One continuous 3-second side-view artillery shot. The Start Frame captures the instant just after one shot: the bright blue streak touching the muzzle is only a brief exposure trail behind one fast shell, never a physical beam. Within the first 2-3 frames the compact white-hot blue shell moves rapidly away from the muzzle while the trailing streak collapses and fades from the muzzle outward, immediately leaving a clear dark gap between cannon and projectile. The shell never pauses, hovers, waits or remains attached to the barrel.

0.0-0.15 s: one violent recoil and a brief handheld camera jolt with natural motion blur; Belicosa does not fire again. 0.15-0.60 s: the single shell crosses the empty sky at extreme speed with only a very short moving blue tail and a growing dark gap behind it. 0.60-0.95 s: it strikes only the central ship's blue organ and disappears into one compact organic impact. 0.95-2.0 s: the damaged blue ship buckles and sheds small fragments while the cannon settles; the camera steadies. 2.0-3.0 s: quiet continuation of the aftermath for trimming.

Preserve the cannon, roof and four ship positions. Yellow, pink-red and brood ships remain intact. No continuous laser line, stationary streak, second projectile, repeated recoil, floating energy ball, giant explosion, camera tracking, new ship, subtitles or watermark.
